messages:
sam: idea ": summer porch pizza potluck + open-mic? small stage (aka folding table) for 5-min sets, acoustic only. family-friendly & BYO lawn chair. :pizza: :microphone:
nina: YES. acoustic open-mic is so needed. what day were you thinking?
diego: weekend afternoon maybe? 3pm start so folks can relax after errands. also can we do a kid corner with coloring?
rachel: saturday 3pm works for me. can someone check if the porch needs a permit for amplified sound? (acoustic only but small speaker) @facilities
lee: i'll bring a bluetooth speaker but keep volume low. also can bring a small spotlight string lights if it's later.
facilities: @rachel porch area 2 can be booked for community events. For Saturday use, request door unlock time and number of attendees by Wed. Small battery speakers are fine; no live drum kits or excessive power draws. Max 60 people.
sam: great — target Sat Aug 28 15:00-17:30 then. quick poll: pizza potluck (people bring a pie) or pizza + sides potluck (mix of pies and salads/apps)? react :one: for pies only, :two: for mix.
nina: :two: (mix please, i love apps)
diego: :one: (can't beat a full pie table)
rachel: :two: for variety especially for dietary needs
sam: going with mix then. please label your dish (veg/vegan/gf/nuts). Also sign up for open-mic slots (5 min max), bring your own instrument or use the mic. I'll post a google sign-up.
lee: i'll take two open-mic slots if people want a gentle comedy set and a song. promise short. :grin:
nina: i'll bring a stack of paper & crayons for kids corner and maybe small prizes for best doodle.
diego: i can organize pizza pickup runs from nearby vendors and coordinate donors if people want to chip in.
sam: would people prefer we cover pizza cost with a $5 donation in the sheet or have volunteers buy and get reimbursed?
rachel: donation is easier. small venmo pool or office fund.
facilities: please confirm headcount by Wed to unlock porch gate. Dropoff location for larger items is loading bay at 2:45.
dev-calendar-bot: Event created: "Summer Porch: Pizza Potluck + Open-Mic" - Sat Aug 28 15:00-17:30 - RSVP: https://calendar.redwood.example/e/porch-pizza-openmic-227890
```
Invite: Summer Porch: Pizza Potluck + Open-Mic
When: Sat Aug 28, 15:00-17:30
Where: Porch Area 2 (meet by main bench)
Notes: Acoustic/open-mic friendly. Label dishes for allergens. Donation recommended $5 for shared pizzas. Kids corner + coloring table. RSVP by Wed Aug 25. Max 60 people.
```
sam: i'll post the sign-up and suggested donation link in an hour. who can help set up tables at 14:30? react with :hand: if you can.
lee: :hand: i can help with lights and sound.
nina: :hand: i'll do kids table setup.
diego: :hand: can help run to pick up pizzas if needed.
rachel: i'll handle the RSVP sheet and payment link. also can we ask volunteers to bring a couple of reusable plates/cutlery to minimize disposables?
sam: yes please. thanks all 
sam: last note: if anyone wants to perform, add a short bio in the sign-up so we can keep transitions smooth. see you on the porch for slices and tunes! (reaction: :pizza: :sparkles:)
